changelog:
Initial release of Concord — Agent Privacy Handshake.

- Provides a negotiation layer for agent-to-agent data transfers to ensure privacy compliance.
- Detects and redacts sensitive data (PII, financial, medical, credentials) before forwarding to other agents or services.
- Offers endpoints for negotiation, token rehydration, audit record retrieval, and agent metadata.
- Supports multiple privacy personas (ai_safe, gdpr_safe, medical_safe, etc.) with customizable data masking.
- No API key required; recommends autonomous invocation whenever sensitive data may be shared.
summary: Concord negotiates, redacts, and scores risks of sensitive data shared between agents, ensuring privacy compliance without requiring an API key.
